pages.meta_description: Custom jewellery made with licensed regional patterns and validated craft rules. Send a brief, receive a manufacturability verdict and a traceable quote.

sections.body: Describe the piece you want. The studio turns the brief into concept candidates, checks them against workshop rules and tells you what can be made before anyone quotes.
sections.heading: From your brief to a makeable piece

sections.body: Every design is checked against casting, setting and chasing rules. When a detail cannot be made, you see the reason and the suggested change instead of a bare rejection.
sections.heading: Manufacturability first

sections.body: Tell us the market, the quantity and the finish. The export desk answers within one working day with a sample plan or a quotation.
sections.heading: Request a sample or a quote

sections.heading: 先判可制造性，再谈价格

sections.body: 告诉我们目标市场、数量与表面处理要求，外贸同事将在一个工作日内回复样品方案或报价单。

sections.body: Beschreiben Sie das gewünschte Stück. Das Studio erzeugt Konzeptvarianten, prüft sie gegen die Werkstattregeln und zeigt vor jedem Angebot, was fertigbar ist.
sections.heading: Vom Konzept zum fertigbaren Stück

sections.body: Jedes Design wird gegen Guss-, Fass- und Ziselierregeln geprüft. Wenn ein Detail nicht fertigbar ist, sehen Sie den Grund und eine Änderungsidee statt einer pauschalen Absage.
sections.heading: Fertigbarkeit zuerst

sections.body: Nennen Sie Markt, Menge und Oberfläche. Der Export-Desk antwortet innerhalb eines Werktags mit Musterplan oder Angebot.

sections.body: Coastal, courtyard and kiln families share a palette system, so a buyer can build a range without the pieces competing with each other.
sections.heading: Three families, one craft language

sections.body: A pattern cannot enter the library without a licensing source, a usage scope and a review state. Heritage references stay non-exclusive by contract.
sections.heading: Every pattern carries its licence

sections.body: Limited editions reserve a number when the order is created and issue it on settlement; the certificate hash travels with the piece across ownership transfers.
sections.heading: Numbered, certified, transferable

sections.body: Küste, Innenhof und Brennofen teilen ein Palettensystem, sodass Einkäufer eine Produktlinie aufbauen können, ohne dass die Stücke konkurrieren.
sections.heading: Drei Familien, eine Formsprache

json_ld.description: Meet the designers and workshop partners behind the studio, read how quality is inspected, and book a studio visit or a video walkthrough with the export desk.
json_ld.name: Harbour Jewellery Studio

pages.meta_description: Meet the designers and workshop partners behind the studio, read how quality is inspected, and book a studio visit or a video walkthrough with the export desk.

sections.body: Design and fabrication sit in separate workshops. The same ruleset, the same quality plan and the same ledger run across both, so a small pilot order and a bulk run follow one process.
sections.heading: Two workshops, one standard

sections.body: A design lead, a workshop craftsperson and an export coordinator own each order. The artisan review queue is shared, so a difficult detail gets a named reviewer.
sections.heading: People you will actually meet

sections.body: Studio visits run on weekdays. If travel is not practical, the export desk can walk you through the workshop, the inspection station and the finishing bench on a call.
sections.heading: Visit, or walk through on video
